Here are the extracted quantitative parameters and their values from the text:

1. \( n_{\text{APC}}(x, t) \) - Density of APCs in T cell zone.
2. \( n_{\text{CD4}}(x, t) \) - Density of CD4\(^+\) T cells in T cell zone.
3. \( n_{\text{CD8}}(x, t) \) - Density of CD8\(^+\) T cells in T cell zone.
4. \( I_2(x, t) \) - Concentration of IL-2 in T cell zone.
5. \( C(x, t) \) - Concentration of type I IFN in T cell zone.
6. \( I(t) \) - Intracellular concentration of IL-2-induced signalling molecules.
7. \( C(i) \) - Intracellular concentration of type I IFN-induced signalling molecules in the ith cell.
8. \( N_{\text{T}}(t) \) - Total number of effector CD8\(^+\) T cells in the body.
9. \( N_{\text{inf}}(t) \) - Total number of infected cells in the body.
10. \( x_1, x_2 \) - Centers of two cells.
11. \( r_1, r_2 \) - Radii of two cells.
12. \( h_{12} \) - Distance between two cells.
13. \( f_{12} \) - Repulsive force between two cells.
14. \( F_i \) - Total force applied to a cell.
15. \( m \) - Mass of the particle.
16. \( \mu \) - Friction factor.
17. \( f_{ij} \) - Potential force between two cells.
18. \( h_{ij} \) - Distance between centers of two cells i and j.
19. \( h_0 \) - Sum of radii of two cells.
20. \( K \) - Positive parameter in force equation.
21. \( h_1 \) - Sum of the incompressible part of each cell.
22. Duration of the cell cycle: 18 hours with a random perturbation of \( -3 \) to 3 hours.
23. Levels of maturity: Two levels for CD4\(^+\) T cells and three levels for CD8\(^+\) T cells.
24. Equation for IL-2 dependent regulatory signal dynamics:
    \[
    \frac{dI}{dt} = \frac{\alpha_1}{hT} I_c(x_i, t) - aI_i
    \]
